title: Brand architecture
slide_intent: Teach designers to identify who should recognize an affiliation before choosing a logo lockup. An employee, a customer and a partner encounter different relationships.
strategic_value: Slack can distinguish an internal initiative from an external extension or partnership using a small vocabulary of lockups.
demonstration: A large, lightweight statement on the left introduces lockups for entities inside and outside Slack. The right column assigns three lockup categories to different audiences.
practical_value: Classify the entity as external-facing, internal-facing or a partnership before turning to the corresponding construction page.

content_islands.name: Introductory statement
content_islands.spec: Place a large thin statement in a narrow left-hand measure. Let its line breaks make the inside/outside distinction prominent.

content_islands.name: Category explanation
content_islands.spec: Start a smaller right column level with the statement. Bold primary, secondary and partnership in the paragraph that introduces the categories.
